author: 陽向 ぽぷら

en.title: The Rusted Little Key and the Star's Forgotten Letter
en.premise: One day, a small, rusted key discovers a letter containing a "final request" from the girl who once cherished him. Determined to return to her side, the little key sets off on a journey with a band of mysterious companions. Crossing vast deserts and pouring his heart into his mission, this is a tale of a small yet grand adventure.

zh.title: 锈迹斑斑的小钥匙与星之遗忘信笺
zh.premise: 某一天，一把生了锈的小钥匙发现了一封信，信中写着曾经珍视他的女孩留下的“最后的请求”。为了能再次回到她的身边，小钥匙决定与一群不可思议的伙伴们一起踏上旅程。跨越沙漠，倾注心意地传递信件，这是一个关于“微小却伟大”的冒险故事。
